question: Among cards illustrated by Stephen Daniele or John Avon that have at least one ruling, count how many belong to sets that (a) include an Italian translation and (b) have a base set size under 150. Only consider rulings issued on or after January 1, 2010.

prediction.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1."XCL_072")
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1."XCL_072" = T2."XCL_090"
INNER JOIN sets AS T3 ON T1."XCL_063" = T3."XCL_099"
INNER JOIN set_translations AS T4 ON T3."XCL_099" = T4."XCL_093"
WHERE T1."XCL_002" IN ('Stephen Daniele', 'John Avon')
  AND T2."XCL_088" >= '2010-01-01'
  AND T4."XCL_092" = 'Italian'
  AND T3."XCL_096" < 150
